record.t: Was sworn in as Representative of the 47th Legislative District.
record.q: I am honored to have been sworn in as the newest Representative of the 47th legislative district.

record.t: Serves as Speaker Pro Tem of the Washington House of Representatives, presiding over the House floor during debate and votes on bills.
record.q: Rep. Chris Stearns serves as Speaker Pro Tem for the House of Representatives and presides over the House floor when members are debating and voting on bills.

record.t: Previously served on the Auburn City Council as its first Native American member.
record.q: Chris, who is Navajo, previously served as the first Native American on the Auburn City Council.

record.office: Director of Native American Affairs, U.S. Department of Energy
record.t: Was appointed by President Bill Clinton as the first Director of Native American Affairs for the U.S. Department of Energy.
record.q: He was also appointed by President Bill Clinton as the first-ever Director of Native American Affairs for the U.S. Department of Energy.

record.t: Introduced House Bill 2579 with Rep. Liz Berry to help fund public broadcasting in Washington.
record.q: Representatives Chris Stearns (D-Auburn) and Liz Berry (D-Queen Anne) have introduced House Bill 2579 to help fund public broadcasting in Washington

record.t: Sponsored House Bill 1222, which the Governor signed into law, on protecting sensitive financial and security data.
record.q: On Monday the Governor signed into law House Bill 1222, sponsored by Rep. Chris Stearns (D-Auburn) to bolster protection for sensitive financial and security data

record.t: Sponsored HB 1461 on clean energy infrastructure.
record.q: Washington will continue to lead on clean energy infrastructure thanks to HB 1461, sponsored by Rep. Chris Stearns (D-Auburn).
